HealthIA ONE exact-candidate Cloud Run cross-revision continuity proof

enabled=true
Purpose: prove that canonical patient state, completed Taskmaster mission, clinical twin provenance and original GCS evidence survive a genuinely new Cloud Run revision while patient A/B isolation remains intact.
Method: prepare durable synthetic state on the current proven revision, force a new revision with the exact same container image using a harmless revision marker, then re-authenticate and independently read back Firestore/GCS/application state.
Cost policy: one controlled continuity proof; no continuous deployment.
